race.comment: YOU'RE THE CHOICE (11) has been narrowly beaten at both appearances this prep, the latest over 1200m at Gosford where she raced handy and just missed as even-money favourite. Should be peaking and drops 3.5kgs so this race sets up nicely. OVERTOOK (5) made it two wins from her last three outings when she edged out JENNI THE JET here at this distance a fortnight back. Lightly raced five-year-old mare who the market continues to underestimate. Big chance again. CAFE AU LAIT (4) returns from a four-month spell. Raced exclusively in Victoria last prep, the best effort a third over 1400m at Flemington. Will come on following this hit-out but she is talented enough to be competitive despite the lay-off. TOTOKA (7) missed the kick and gave away a huge start before flying late to get within a length over OVERTOOK here two weeks ago. Right in contention but needs to get her manners right. Distance specialist ME ME (8) scored a tidy first-up win at Kembla and makes each-way appeal.
